The '''Heter-Valve''', commonly referred to as an '''energy converter valve''', was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. Pulling the trigger on the weapon opened the Heter-Valve, allowing [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] to flow from the [[gas chamber]] into the [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]].<ref name="CRFG" /> A damaged Heter-Valve could release too much gas into the XCiter; while this could increase the weapon's damage per shot, it also increased the chance of an overload that could destroy the blaster.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
